built_by: hand-authored; executed by ml/tune/run_train.py (no run performed)
objective: Fix the four failure modes the v2 audit isolated -- administrative boilerplate copied into `issue`, `requested_action` redundancy, terse-note under-extraction, and coarse-ontology domain confusion -- without regressing the v2 single-topic and multi-topic benchmarks.

smoke.note: tag 'finetuned' in eval_smoke.py; the stale 'finetuned-v2' artifact gave a misleading 0/4

regression.role: regression only -- scores against the uncleaned v1 weak label, so a model that learns to strip boilerplate will look worse here
regression only -- multi-topic recall and topic_count_accuracy

target.role: primary -- scored against the cleaned reference label, the only benchmark that measures the behaviour v3 is being trained for

control.description: v2 attempt-10 training data, unchanged. Reproduces the baseline.

treatment.description: v1 single-topic + multitopic, with the four changes below.

arms.why_both: Every change below targets a mechanism the audit measured, but boilerplate stripping and terse-note upsampling both trade against the v1 issue ROUGE baseline. A single treatment run cannot attribute a regression. Run control first to confirm the harness reproduces the baseline under the seeded pipeline, then treatment.

changes.name: boilerplate cleaning
changes.targets: Administrative boilerplate copied into `issue` (61.9% of v2 training examples carry it; the model reproduces it in 217/329 frozen predictions).
changes.action: Run the same sentence-level filter the eval_v3 reference labeler uses (BOILER_SENT + _DANGLING) over the `issue` field of every single-topic training target. Close the `надає згоду` / `згоду надає` word-order gap that `_ADMIN_CLAUSE` misses.
changes.cost: issue ROUGE-L against the frozen v1 label will drop; that is the intended effect, and eval_v3 is the benchmark that rewards it.

changes.name: requested_action decoupled
changes.targets: `requested_action` is redundant with `issue` in 93.9% of v1 training examples (2,124 substring + 333 exact of 2,616), so the field carries almost no information the model can learn to generalise.
changes.action: Populate `requested_action` only when an explicit request verb is present in the source text, and otherwise emit the empty string. The eval_v3 `H` category (12 cases) asserts exactly this.
changes.cost: requested_action_presence_match on the frozen benchmark will fall, because the frozen target contains actions where the text has no verb. Report both.

changes.name: terse-note upsampling
changes.targets: Terse complaints (<150 chars) are 57.6% of the 2023 slice and essentially absent from validation and test, so the model is evaluated outside the register it must handle. 1210/2099 of 2023, 1/1691 of 2024, 1/1594 of 2025, 0/1453 of 2026.
changes.action: Upsample the 178 train kernels that survive the note filter and are >= 25 characters, 8-12x, targeting roughly 1200-1500 terse examples. Prefer records that condense well (boilerplate removed, wrapper words deleted) so the target stays faithful.
changes.cost: None expected on the frozen benchmark, which contains no terse records; this is new capability, not a trade.

changes.name: multi-topic share restored
changes.targets: `meta.json` reports multitopic_share 0.3448 against a stated 0.368, an unresolved bookkeeping discrepancy; the real-vs-synthetic mix is 264 real copies vs 2871 synthetic (8.4% real).
changes.action: Rebuild the multitopic stream so the reported share is computed from the emitted file rather than declared, and raise the real fraction by decomposing more held-in train records instead of leaning on synthetic combinations.
changes.cost: More train records; ~2x current synthetic count is not affordable, so prefer additional real decompositions.

schema_validity.note: The v2 baseline already reaches this on eval_v3; a drop means the output format regressed.

boilerplate_leak.metric: eval_v3 boilerplate_leak_rate (share of predicted `issue` fields containing response-delivery boilerplate)
boilerplate_leak.note: baseline = 217/329 frozen predictions. Target is stated against eval_v3 where the reference is clean by construction, so the achievable floor is near zero rather than exactly zero.

terse_single_topic.note: No v2 baseline exists -- the frozen benchmark contains no records under 150 characters. Measured for the first time by this suite; report the number rather than gating on it in the first run.

multi_topic_count.note: v2 reached 0.8588 on the multitopic suite. eval_v3 is harder by construction (no case states its connective explicitly).

multi_topic_recall_no_regression.note: Floor, not a goal: C1-C3 must not cost two-topic recall.

frozen_domain_no_regression.note: Floor with ~2 points of headroom for the ontology noise the audit documented (traffic lights labelled sanitation). v1 scored 0.845, so anything below 0.82 means a real regression.

frozen_issue_rouge_expected_drop.note: A drop here is EXPECTED and desired: the frozen target contains the boilerplate C1 removes. Gating on it would punish the fix. Recorded so the drop is not mistaken for a regression.

smoke_multi_topic.note: All 4 two-topic smoke cases must fire. This is the smallest human-curated set and the most direct read on whether multi-topic extraction actually works.

action_empty_when_absent.metric: eval_v3 category H share of cases with a non-empty predicted requested_action
action_empty_when_absent.note: Measures C2 directly. 12 cases, all with no request verb in the text.

budget.estimate: 2 arms x 800 iterations; roughly 2x the v2 attempt-10 wall time. No training was run to produce this plan.

preconditions: Control arm must be run first under the seeded pipeline and must land within 1 point of the recorded baseline on every frozen metric, or the harness itself is not trustworthy and the treatment result is uninterpretable.
ml/tune/run_train.py must seed the data-shuffle iterator (see ml/reports/reproducibility_audit.md) -- otherwise control and treatment differ by batch order as well as by dataset.
The multitopic_share discrepancy in ml/data/tune/v2/meta.json must be resolved in the rebuilt v3 meta, not carried forward.

leakage_policy.rule: No v3 training example text may appear in any benchmark.
leakage_policy.identity_rule: Deduplicate and detect leakage by normalised text, never by `uid` -- the portal reuses case numbers across years. 130 uids span splits with unrelated text.
leakage_policy.held_out_rule: Augmentation may only be derived from train-split content. Held-out records may only be used to build eval_v3.

explicitly_out_of_scope: Changing ml/data/gold/annotation_schema.json. The 12-label / 13-enum mismatch is documented, not fixed here; changing it would invalidate every recorded number.
Populating the `benefits` and `other` domains, which have zero training support.
Any model artifact, adapter, or fused-model change.
Re-splitting the frozen date-based train/validation/test boundaries.
